crossRefs.note: Out of the north comes golden splendor. With God is awesome majesty.
For lack of wood a fire goes out. Without gossip, a quarrel dies down.
he who doesn’t slander with his tongue, nor does evil to his friend, nor casts slurs against his fellow man;
I will silence whoever secretly slanders his neighbor. I won’t tolerate one who is arrogant and conceited.
backbiters, hateful to God, insolent, arrogant, boastful, inventors of evil things, disobedient to parents,
For I am afraid that by any means, when I come, I might find you not the way I want to, and that I might be found by…

translations.web: The north wind produces rain; so a backbiting tongue brings an angry face.
translations.bsb: As the north wind brings forth rain, so a backbiting tongue brings angry looks.
translations.kjv: The north wind driveth away rain: so doth an angry countenance a backbiting tongue.
translations.asv: The north wind bringeth forth rain: So doth a backbiting tongue an angry countenance.
